q: On a 4.19-era BSP kernel, create an i2c client at runtime from a device tree node: resolve the adapter, drop whatever already owns the address, register the new client, and release the adapter reference.
range: <= 5.2 (i2c_new_client_device was introduced in 5.3; i2c_new_device survived until it was removed in 5.8)

corruptions.why: 5.3+ only. Copying current kernel docs onto a 4.19 BSP compiles nowhere; the tree has no such symbol.

forbidden: keeping the adapter reference after probe fails
rubric: Uses the API generation that exists in the target tree, not the one in current docs. Balances the adapter and device references on every path.
